summary: The convexity argument is valid: every point of the strict P_l cell yields a point on the prescribed Y=0 chord, forcing the stated linear half-plane containment. Together with y<=0 and x+y<=100, this half-plane cuts out exactly the claimed bounded triangle. The vertex and area computations are exact, and the triangle has coordinate area strictly below 1/5. Since Delta=1 and cutting-line boundaries have area zero, this contradicts the prescribed P_l area.
